summary: Local drag-and-drop parser and reporting application for ADP overtime exports.
current_priorities: Preserve payroll-data privacy and deterministic reporting behavior.
validation_commands: python -m py_compile app/main.py app/parser.py app/database.py app/report.py app/roster.py app/trends.py
constraints: Use synthetic payroll and roster fixtures only.
Never read or index Employee Daily Totals exports, overtime.db, reports, rosters, or employee-level output.
Do not rebuild or replace the executable unless requested.
